title: 95% of McDonald's Aren't Run by McDonald's #shorts
summary: About 95% of McDonald's 45,356 restaurants are franchised.
sources: McDonald's 2025 Form 10-K (Item 1): "Of the 45,356 McDonald's restaurants at year-end 2025, approximately 95% were franchised"; conventional franchisees pay "rent and royalties based upon a percent of sales, with specified minimum rent payments"; the Company "generally owns or secures a long-term lease on the land and building"; operating margin 46.1%; systemwide sales $139.4 billion: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/63908/000006390826000035/mcd-20251231.htm

McDonald's fourth quarter and full year 2025 results (Feb 11, 2026), income statement: revenues from franchised restaurants $16,548M; company-owned and operated sales $9,690M; franchised occupancy expenses $2,618M; company-operated restaurant expenses $8,268M; operating income $12,393M; net income $8,563M: https://mcdonalds.mediaroom.com/2026-02-11-McDONALDS-REPORTS-FOURTH-QUARTER-AND-FULL-YEAR-2025-RESULTS
Our calculations: franchised margin $16,548M - $2,618M = $13,930M; company-operated margin $9,690M - $8,268M = $1,422M (about 9.8x).
Harry J. Sonneborn proposed that Kroc own the land under McDonald's restaurants and lease it to franchisees: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harry_J._Sonneborn
Kroc bought the McDonald brothers' stake in 1961 for $2.7 million; at end-2025 the company owned about 56% of the land and 80% of the restaurant buildings: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/McDonald%27s

scenes.narration: {95 percent|Ninety-five percent} of McDonald's restaurants aren't run by McDonald's.
The franchisees pay rent and a royalty, both a percent of every sale.
And McDonald's often owns the land they cook on.
It's a landlord that sells burgers.
